scope: Method-qualification control of an existing conditional task-loss result. Not a new attack, full native online training, defense certification or independent replication.

allocator.limit: Allocator only; CUDA context and external allocations are not covered.

provenance.adapter: Upstream MPC/model/wrappers; Gymnasium Env inheritance bridge; TensorDict to_module preserve_module_state=False restores upstream historical registration semantics; bridge removed TensorDict state-dict metadata keys around upstream checkpoint conversion; selected tasks retain original task IDs and full padding/action masks.

analysis.limits: Selective recovery would show sensitivity to the researcher's omitted task-loss paths, not uniquely identify every cause. No recovery excludes this fixed simple correction only; it does not establish non-normality, a new security mechanism or general harm.
analysis.statistics: One previously used development root, descriptive paired contrasts only. No population p-value, confidence interval or ASR.
